summary: A groovebox firmware that runs a 909, an 808, two 303s and a slice-based break player at the same time, for writing beats and acid lines on the FM-1.
features: 909 and 808 kits with 11 voices each, two Open303 basslines
TB-3PO line generator writes and mutates 303 patterns
Per-part step length up to 64 and rate; 32 patterns, chains and song mode
Knob motion recording, p-locks and per-step probability
USB and TRS MIDI with fixed CC map; class-compliant stereo USB audio
Beta: very busy patterns can reduce sound quality; no breaks included
